name: Calypsow
summary: Defensive tall fescue blend with strong disease depth and summer-stress focus.
buyHint: Heritage / specialty turf dealers. Ask for Calypsow by name.
notes: Published cultivar set. Unweighted when scoring unless bag percents are on your tag.

name: Resilience II
summary: Equal-part elite blend with strong transition-zone and appearance traits.
buyHint: Twin City Seed and dealers that stock TCS blends. 5–50 lb bags.
notes: 4th Millennium SRP may be missing from the 2018–2023 NTEP extract — absence is a data gap, not a quality judgment.

name: Optimum
summary: Four-way of A-LIST / Lateral Spread cultivars aimed at heat, traffic, and brown patch.
buyHint: Mountain View Seeds dealers and many SiteOne / pro shops. Confirm the current bag tag.
notes: From the Mountain View Optimum tech sheet. Bag percentages vary by lot.

name: Kentucky 31
summary: The forage-type fescue still sold at box stores. Coarse, light green, and a useful NTEP check — not an elite lawn blend.
buyHint: Home Depot, Lowe’s, Ace, and farm co-ops. Compare elite blends against this, don’t start here if you want turf-type density.
notes: Included as the widely available baseline so ‘best for my zone’ has something cheap to beat.

name: Turf Builder Tall Fescue Mix
summary: Widely sold tall fescue mix with fertilizer in the bag. Cultivar names are not published on the product page.
buyHint: Home Depot, Lowe’s, Walmart, and Scotts’ site. Check the tag — lots change.
notes: Proprietary retail mix. Cultivars are not on the public tag, so this is a buy option without an NTEP fit score.

name: Black Beauty Original
summary: 100% turf-type tall fescue sold heavily on Amazon. Lot tags rotate among Jonathan Green’s Black Beauty family cultivars.
buyHint: Amazon, Ace, and jonathangreen.com. Confirm the current bag tag.
notes: Cultivar list changes by lot (e.g. Golconda / Toltec / Tonto). Not mapped to NTEP because the published mix is not a fixed formula.

name: Turf Saver RTF
summary: Patented RTF tall fescue blend sold through Barenbrug dealers. Rhizomes, not a published NTEP cultivar list.
buyHint: Barenbrug distributors, Johnston Seed, and many pro shops.
notes: The RTF component and companion cultivars are not a stable public tag we can map to the 2018–2023 tall fescue extract.

name: Smart Seed Bermudagrass
summary: Pennington’s boxed bermuda + fertilizer mix for southern lawns. Cultivar names are not on the product page.
buyHint: Home Depot, Lowe’s, and pennington.com. Plant when soil is consistently warm.
notes: Proprietary retail mix. Cultivars not on the tag — buy option only, no NTEP fit score.

name: Turf Builder Bermudagrass
summary: Scotts bermuda mix with Root-Building Nutrition. Cultivar names are not published.
buyHint: Box stores and Scotts’ site. Late spring / early summer seeding.
notes: Proprietary retail mix. Cultivars not on the tag — buy option only, no NTEP fit score.

name: Yukon Bermudagrass
summary: Named Yukon seed sold online (Outsidepride and Hancock). Strong winter-hardiness reputation; not in the 2019 NTEP bermuda cycle.
buyHint: Outsidepride, Amazon, and Hancock Seed. Coated seed is easier to spread.
notes: Yukon is a real named cultivar, but it is not in the 2019 National Bermudagrass Test extract — listed as a known data gap.

name: Riviera Bermudagrass
summary: OSU-bred seeded bermuda sold as a named bag. In the 2019 NTEP bermuda trial.
buyHint: Hancock Seed, Seed Barn, and Johnston Seed when in stock.
notes: Single named cultivar. Crop shortages happen — confirm availability before you plan a full lawn.

name: Monaco Bermudagrass
summary: Johnston Seed / Barenbrug Monaco with Yellow Jacket coating. In the 2019 NTEP bermuda trial.
buyHint: Barenbrug distributors and Johnston Seed. Often sold coated.
notes: Single named cultivar from the bg19 trial. Availability varies by season.

name: Copperhead Bermudagrass
summary: DLF Copperhead (DLF-460/3048) seeded bermuda. In the 2019 NTEP bermuda trial.
buyHint: DLF wholesale / pro turf dealers. Ask for Copperhead by name.
notes: Single named cultivar from the bg19 trial.

name: Common Bermuda (unhulled)
summary: Unhulled common bermuda — the budget seeded option, coarser than turf-type named cultivars.
buyHint: Hancock Seed ships coated or raw. Unhulled is more forgiving on planting date.
notes: Common bermuda is not a named NTEP entry in the 2019 trial. Included as the cheap seeded baseline for warm-zone shoppers.
